content_blocks.steps_heading: Your PMP Certification Pathway in Fort Wayne

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires either a four-year degree plus three years of project-management experience, or a high school diploma plus five years of equivalent experience. Review PMI's full eligibility criteria to confirm you meet the education and hours threshold before enrolling.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Training
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP course. Attend all required sessions at your own pace from anywhere, covering the PMBOK Guide and real-world project scenarios. Our active certified practitioners deliver the content in real time, with interactive Q&A and group discussion.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After completing your 35 contact hours, submit your PMP application directly to PMI with your education and experience documentation. Pay PMI's exam fee and await application approval, which typically takes several business days to complete.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources—practice questions, study guides, and review sessions—to strengthen your readiness. Schedule your computer-based exam with Pearson VUE and sit for the PMP credential exam at a testing center or via remote proctoring.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your Credential
steps_items.text: Earn Professional Development Units (PDUs) across a standard three-year renewal cycle to keep your PMP active. Pursue training, volunteer work, or other PMI-approved activities, then renew your certification before expiration to sustain your professional standing.
